title: aster lateriflorus
intro: Aster lateriflorus, commonly known as calico aster or white panicle aster, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This perennial plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Aster lateriflorus include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and showing antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
